text: In Aristotle's Categories, concrete individuals such as this particular horse or this particular man are called ___ substances, whereas their species and genera are secondary substances.
explanation: Primary substances are the ultimate subjects of predication (the individual horse or man); secondary substances are the species and genera (horse, animal) predicated of them. This ranking expresses Aristotle's immanent realism, on which individuals are ontologically basic and universals exist only in them.
